name: com.castsoftware.pl1.programnamefromfilename
title: IBM PL/I Program Name From File Name
description: Companion extension for com.castsoftware.pl1 (IBM PL/I Analyzer): when present in the analysis, PL/I main procedure objects are named after their source file's own base name instead of the coded PROC label. Add this extension to the analysis to enable that naming convention; remove it to revert to the default (coded label). See PL-577.
